subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

Of course it is. They just set around- _______, maybe, when there's a war.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**except**" means not including; other than. (सिवाय)
 
• In the context of the sentence, "except" correctly implies that the behavior might change only under the condition of there being a war.
 
• The other options: "**expect**," "**accept**," and "**assent**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Of course it is. They just set around- except__, maybe, when there's a war.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Expect (अपेक्षा करना)**: means to regard something as likely to happen.
 
• **Accept (स्वीकार करना)**: means to consent to receive or undertake something offered.
 
• **Assent (सहमति)**: means to express approval or agreement.
